title: Chanan ben Avishalom
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: The form Avishalom, not Avshalom, is the reading Hyman cites from [Tosafot on Yoma 38b](https://www.sefaria.org/Tosafot_on_Yoma.38b.4.1). He was one of Jerusalem’s judges of penalties during the Temple period. At the beginning of [Mishnah Ketubot, chapter 13](https://www.sefaria.org/Mishnah_Ketubot.13.1): “Two judges of penalties were in Jerusalem, Admon and Chanan ben Avishalom.” Chanan rules, “She shall swear at the end.” Rabban Yochanan ben Zakkai endorses Chanan; the sons of the high priests disagree with him on both rulings.[^1]

notes.text: In the linked Mishnah, the wife is claiming maintenance after her husband has gone overseas. The sons of the high priests disagree with Chanan about when she must swear. In [the next mishnah](https://www.sefaria.org/Mishnah_Ketubot.13.2), they disagree over reimbursement for someone who supported her. Tosafot attributes the reading Avishalom to Rabbeinu Tam.
